## Checklist

- [ ] `go test ./...` and `golangci-lint run` pass locally
- [ ] User-visible changes have a `CHANGELOG.md` line under the unreleased version
- [ ] New or changed metrics have golden tests in `internal/metrics`
- [ ] UI changes were eyeballed against the seeded demo team (`go run . seed`)
